description: Verify that the build log contains no lines with the word 'error' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains no lines with the word 'fail' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains the phrase 'Build succeeded' or 'Build complete' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log does not contain any stack traces or file paths indicating compilation failures (e.g., '.cpp', '.java', '.py' followed by ': line').
